Atelier is a project type for Quarto websites.
It gives a documentation site an accessible design that comes from one `_brand.yml` file.

Mickaël Canouil makes Atelier and the other Quarto extensions in this family.
He keeps the source code on GitHub.

This page uses the `trestles` template.
Quarto has four other about templates: `jolla`, `solana`, `marquee`, and `broadside`.
